span.p:
Submit Agent Payload:
- agent_name
- description
- capabilities comma-separated
- endpoint optional HTTP URL

span.p:
Invoke PyNaCl: Generate Cryptographic Ed25519 Keypair
- 32-byte Public Signing Key
- 32-byte Private Seed / Private Key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Base58-Btc Encode Prefixed Bytes
Yields Multibase String with 'z' prefix

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Construct W3C DID Document:
- id: did:key:z...
- verificationMethod: Ed25519VerificationKey2020
- authentication & assertionMethod references

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Insert into 'agents' Table:
- agent_id: UUID4
- did: did:key:z...
- capabilities, endpoint, status='AVAILABLE'
- reputation_score=5.0

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Insert into 'agent_trust_states' Table:
- did: did:key:z...
- temporal_trust_score=1.00
- trust_state='TRUSTED'
- last_updated=now

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Insert into 'trust_audit_trails' Table:
- previous_state='NONE'
- new_state='TRUSTED'
- reason='Agent Initial Registration Genesis'

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Create W3C VC -> PyLD URDNA2015 -> PyNaCl Sign -> Insert into 'stored_vcs'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Assemble Response Payload:
- agent_id
- did
- did_document
- public_key_multibase
- trust_state: TRUSTED
- temporal_trust_score: 1.0
